scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @padaria/shared && npm run build --workspace @padaria/db && npm run build --workspace @padaria/api && npm run build --workspace @padaria/web-vue
scripts.check: npm run check:texto && npm run check:arquitetura && npm run check --workspace @padaria/shared && npm run check --workspace @padaria/db && npm run check --workspace @padaria/api && npm run check --workspace @padaria/web-vue && npm run check --workspace @padaria/tests
scripts.lint: eslint api db shared tests web-vue scripts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.lint:fix: eslint api db shared tests web-vue scripts eslint.config.mjs --fix
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run lint:deps && npm run format:check && npm run check && npm test && npm run audit:deps
scripts.test:complete: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:deps && npm run check && npm run build && npm test && npm run audit:deps && npm run knip && npm run depcheck
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -p padaria-dev -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait db
scripts.dev:api: set DATABASE_URL=postgresql://padaria:padaria@localhost:5543/padaria&& set BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=dev-secret-change-me-dev-secret-change-me&& set AUTH_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4100&& set WEB_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5174&& set PORT=4100&& set HOST=0.0.0.0&& npm run api:dev:prepare --workspace @padaria/api && npm run dev --workspace @padaria/api
scripts.dev:vue: set PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4100&& set NUXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4100&& npm run dev --workspace @padaria/web-vue -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5174
scripts.dev:down: docker compose -p padaria-dev -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml down --remove-orphans
scripts.compose:up: docker compose -p padaria-dev -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.compose:down: docker compose -p padaria-dev -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml down -v --remove-orphans
